item: ZCode Releases & Updates | GLM-5.3 Coding Agent
Release notes and desktop downloads for every ZCode version.
3.14.1Released Sep 21, 2026
Download
Draft references are now inserted correctly after selecting a plugin.
Draft content and thinking text are no longer lost when collapsing a plan or minimizing the input box.
Unnamed providers no longer lose their identity information when selecting a service provider.
The onboarding guide no longer pops up automatically for existing users, and will not reappear after a restart once dismissed.
Fixed an issue where Computer Control might fail to start.
3.14.0Released Sep 19, 2026
Added dynamic workflows that use a single script to orchestrate multiple sub-agents collaborating on complex tasks
Quickly start a workflow from the plus menu in the input box or via the /workflow command
Added switching between Office and Coding modes
New keyboard shortcut settings: record custom key combinations that take effect instantly
Added a three-step onboarding guide that recommends tasks and plugins based on your role
Archived tasks now support batch deletion
Improved the phone remote control service
Added About and Check for Updates entries to the Help menu
The approval dialog now supports directly granting full access
Start Plan can now be used independently
Added an invitation rewards center
Improved the way CUA is invoked
Fixed an issue with abnormal uploads in the repository wiki
Fixed occasional login failures
Fixed an issue where tabs in the remote built-in browser couldn't be closed
On Windows, locating files no longer opens multiple duplicate windows
Idle-time tasks now show a friendly message when the run limit is exceeded
Fixed an issue where the plugin update badge was not fully displayed
Fixed an issue where the model selection menu width didn't fit properly
When a tool call fails, the error is now displayed correctly, and incomplete cards no longer remain
Sessions with running background workflows no longer disappear from the task list
When canceling or resuming a workflow is rejected, the specific reason is now explained
Fixed inaccurate display of Start Plan benefits and balance
Fixed an issue where the UI occasionally went black after upgrading
Fixed an issue where custom model configuration failed to load on Windows
Fixed an issue where the input box position jumped after switching interface modes
3.12.3Released Sep 17, 2026
Improved interaction between Plan Mode and queued messages
Added OpenCode Go provider template and site mapping
Improved display of provider template names, icons, and plan banners
Improved database initialization and upgrade process
Support uploading, reading, and previewing PDF files in conversations
Support previewing images, videos, and other media files in conversations
Plugins can now be installed per workspace
Shows a reminder when a plugin update is available, with direct updating
Displays the specific reason when an operation is blocked, making it easier to handle
Sidebar tabs support closing with middle-click and remember display state for each session
Draft tasks can now also be viewed in the sidebar
The built-in browser now remembers its last window size
Local file links in the built-in browser can now be opened in the system default browser
Improved Weekend/Global Plan claim reminders, with clearer status and expiration info
Fixed Provider config reading blocking
Added a re-login option when plan retrieval fails, and fixed Key forced refresh not being triggered after login
Improved untracked file counting performance
Fixed retry after interrupted streaming responses
Fixed provider config reading errors
Fixed OpenRouter compatibility issues and improved connection testing
Fixed sub-agents appearing in the task list after resuming
Fixed missing Plan Mode menu descriptions
Adjusted tool usage limits for idle-time tasks
Improved session startup speed
Fixed model switching and context loss during active conversations
Improved context usage display, with tap-to-view support on touch devices
Fixed model config sync issues after remote reconnection
Improved connection and deployment stability in remote workspaces and WSL environments
Fixed occasional hangs during SSH connection or sending
Fixed login issues such as expired sessions and authorization callback failures
Fixed official MCP connection issues and improved failure messages
Fixed official plugin errors affecting session recovery
Fixed plugin menu display issues and uninstall hangs
Fixed occasional unresponsiveness of computer operations and tasks being incorrectly restarted on Windows
Fixed pending confirmation actions not showing in remote workspaces
Fixed content search errors during conversation generation
Improved display performance for long command outputs
Fixed incorrect file path and reference display and broken navigation
Fixed incorrect scroll position when opening a session
Adjusted the display width of user messages
Fixed display of empty thinking content
Improved browser window isolation between tasks
Reduced file watcher resource usage for large workspaces on Linux
Fixed new Linux installations being obscured by old shortcuts
Fixed Linux auto-update issues
Fixed inaccurate deletion result messages for scheduled tasks
3.11.2Released Sep 4, 2026
Support for uploading, reading, and previewing PDF files in conversations
Support for previewing media files such as images and videos in conversations
Plugins can now be installed per workspace
A notification appears when a plugin update is available, with an option to update directly
When an action is blocked, the specific reason is shown to make resolution easier
Sidebar tabs can now be closed with the middle mouse button, and their visibility is remembered per session
Draft tasks can now also be viewed from the sidebar
The built-in browser remembers the window size from the last time it was opened
Local file links in the built-in browser can now be opened in the system default browser
Improved Weekend/Global Plan claim reminders, with clearer display of status and expiration details
Conversations no longer switch models midway or lose context
Context usage display is more accurate, and can now be tapped to view on touch devices
Fixed an issue where model configuration synced incorrectly after a remote reconnection
Improved connection and deployment stability for remote workspaces and WSL environments
Fixed an issue where SSH would occasionally hang when connecting or sending
Fixed login issues such as expired sessions and authorization callback failures
Fixed official MCP connection issues, with clearer failure messages
Official plugin loading timeouts or data errors no longer affect session recovery
Fixed garbled plugin menu display, and uninstalling no longer gets stuck
Fixed an issue on Windows where computer operations occasionally became unresponsive and tasks were incorrectly restarted
Fixed an issue where actions pending confirmation were not shown in remote workspaces
Searching now works properly while a conversation is generating
Command output is automatically truncated when too long, preventing UI lag
Fixed issues with incorrect file path and reference display and broken navigation
Fixed an issue where the scroll position was incorrect when opening a session
Adjusted the display width of user messages for better readability of long content
Empty thinking content is no longer displayed
Browser windows for different tasks are now independent and do not interfere with each other
Reduced file-watching resource usage for large workspaces on Linux
Fixed an issue on Linux where the app was obscured by old shortcuts after installation
Fixed inaccurate result messages when deleting scheduled tasks
3.10.2Released Aug 31, 2026
Added free early claiming of the Weekend Plan, and you can invite friends to claim it together
Plugins referenced in prompt templates now support one-click installation, with clearer progress indicators
Added a skills shortcut entry to the input box menu
Thinking traces now support content search, with more complete records that are expanded by default
MCP servers now support configuring the protocol version, with guidance prompts when negotiation fails
Edited messages can now be sent immediately without waiting in the queue
When a conversation turn ends, you can view an execution summary and duration
The "Browser" menu in Settings has been renamed to "Browser Control"
Improved the login authorization flow and fixed an issue where callbacks occasionally failed
Fixed an intermittent mcp oauth failure
Model responses that are occasionally interrupted or blank will now automatically retry
Fixed an issue where queued messages were lost and interrupted task statuses displayed incorrectly after an error
Unified tool execution status wording; thinking process labels are now more concise and clearer
Fixed issues where task action hints were clipped and task information was scrambled on touchscreens
Unread markers are now cleared immediately after opening the task timeline
Raised the threshold for converting pasted long text into attachments, reducing false conversions
Fixed an issue where a single tilde was incorrectly rendered as strikethrough
The input box no longer loses focus when switching sidebars
Input box reference and command menus are now displayed more clearly, and search no longer retries repeatedly
Fixed an issue where multiple skill directories in a workspace could not be listed together
Fixed issues where some plugin skills were not recognized or their names displayed inconsistently
Usage statistics now show the last seven days by default, with clearer charts and value labels
Fixed an issue on Windows where background processes remained after exiting
Fixed several issues with Computer Use on macOS and in remote workspaces
Improved browser control session stability; page scripts now execute as expected
Fixed an issue where the menu in the mobile remote interface extended beyond the screen
Fixed an issue where model status displayed incorrectly after a plan expired
Fixed an error that occurred when modifying model configuration while a task was running
